title: Kaco First Roller heart pen
author: lakhanadewar
prompt: Create an anatomy breakdown of the Kaco First Roller Heart Pen: minimalist matte white or black twist-action rollerball, clip-less, flat cap top. Twisting extends a 0.5 mm fine tip from a tapered nose cone while a hidden 3D red heart shifts into a clear window on the upper barrel; twisting back hides both. Include the lower grip barrel, mid-body twist seam, translucent window, red heart core, upper barrel and quick-dry black gel ink refill, mapped top to bottom and outer to inner.
